event_name: Document 34 Date 01 August 2020 Time 17:14 2020 BRITISH GRAND PRIX 30 July - 2 August 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Alleged unsafe release of Car 16 from the garage
offence: Alleged Breach of Article 28.13 (a) of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: Having reviewed the video evidence and having reviewed previous instances, the Stewards determined that this situation was not particularly unsafe.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 16 Alleged Unsafe Release
